headline: Meta Connect 2026: Camera-free smart glasses may be unveiled
summary: Meta's annual Connect event is set to reveal updates on AI and wearables. A potential camera-free smart glasses model could address privacy concerns.
details: Meta Connect 2026 is happening soon, with CEO Mark Zuckerberg expected to share updates on the company's advancements in AI and wearable technology, particularly smart glasses.

The event comes amid significant scrutiny over the privacy implications of current smart glasses, which allow users to covertly record others. This has led to the product line being criticized as "pervert glasses."
A key announcement expected at Connect could be a rumored camera-free version of Meta's smart glasses, aimed at alleviating privacy and harassment concerns.
Meta has already implemented privacy fixes and launched a new marketing campaign to address public perception, but further updates are anticipated on stage.

Beyond smart glasses, Meta Connect has historically showcased updates to its VR hardware and software. While VR ambitions have scaled back, a recent leak suggests new mixed reality headwear might be revealed.
Zuckerberg's keynote is scheduled for Wednesday, September 23rd, at 7 PM ET / 4 PM PT, and will focus on "how Meta is building a future for everyone."

A key announcement expected at Connect could be a rumored camera-free version of Meta's smart glasses, aimed at alleviating privacy and harassment concerns.

Meta has already implemented privacy fixes and launched a new marketing campaign to address public perception, but further updates are anticipated on stage.

Beyond smart glasses, Meta Connect has historically showcased updates to its VR hardware and software. While VR ambitions have scaled back, a recent leak suggests new mixed reality headwear might be revealed.

Zuckerberg's keynote is scheduled for Wednesday, September 23rd, at 7 PM ET / 4 PM PT, and will focus on "how Meta is building a future for everyone."
